tasks.spec:
You are a build worker writing a deterministic graph transform. OFFLINE: no network, no git, no MCP, no skills; write only in your working directory.

CONTEXT: the Mott Bland pathway graph embeds the filler sentence 'One moment while I check the schedule for you.' in about 20 node prompts. Measured tonight on the live line: that filler lands 10.5-11.8s after the patient's message, a mere 0.33s before the real answer - it reassures nobody and costs an extra SMS per turn. Ankit's ruling: kill the filler, one answer per turn.

WRITE ./strip_filler.py, usage: strip_filler.py <in.json> <out.json>. Behavior: load the pathway graph JSON; in every string field anywhere in the structure, remove every occurrence of the exact sentence 'One moment while I check the schedule for you.' and tidy the residue (collapse doubled spaces, strip a space left hanging before a newline or at line start/end where the sentence was removed - never touch any other text); count total occurrences removed and print REMOVED=<n>; if n is 0 print REMOVED=0 and exit 1 (refusal - wrong input); assert the node count and edge count are identical before and after and print NODES=<n> EDGES=<n>; write the transformed JSON to <out.json>; any assertion failure prints why and exits 1.

VERIFY before finishing: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m py_compile strip_filler.py passes; no-args run exits nonzero printing usage; running it on a tiny self-made test JSON containing the sentence twice prints REMOVED=2 and produces parseable output. Final message <=15 lines.
tasks.check: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m py_compile strip_filler.py || exit 1; if python3 strip_filler.py >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'CHECK FAILED: no-args must exit nonzero'; exit 1; fi; PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 strip_filler.py /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/pathway-v92.json ./v92_nofiller.json > strip_run.txt 2>&1 || { echo 'CHECK FAILED: real transform failed:'; cat strip_run.txt; exit 1; }; grep -q '^REMOVED=20$' strip_run.txt || { echo "CHECK FAILED: expected REMOVED=20 on the real v92 graph, got: $(grep '^REMOVED=' strip_run.txt)"; exit 1; }; python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('v92_nofiller.json')); import sys; body=open('v92_nofiller.json').read(); assert 'One moment while I check the schedule for you' not in body, 'filler sentence still present'; print('output parses; filler fully gone')" || exit 1; echo 'PASS: 20 fillers stripped from real v92 graph; structure counts asserted by the tool'
tasks.verified: The exact filler sentence stripped from all 20 node prompts of the real v92 graph by an executed deterministic transform, with node/edge counts asserted unchanged and the output proven clean.

tasks.spec: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/checks/check_v91_graph.py /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workT6mint/t6-strip-builder/v92_nofiller.json > validate.txt 2>&1; rc=$?; tail -12 validate.txt; exit $rc
tasks.check: if grep -qiE 'usage:|error:|traceback' validate.txt && ! grep -qiE 'pass|ok|assert' validate.txt; then echo 'FAIL: validator did not run cleanly (interface or crash):'; head -8 validate.txt; exit 1; fi; grep -qiE '(pass|ok|35)' validate.txt || { echo 'FAIL: no pass indication in validator output:'; tail -8 validate.txt; exit 1; }; echo "PASS: validator accepted the stripped graph - $(tail -1 validate.txt)"
tasks.verified: The 35-assertion canonical graph validator executed against the filler-stripped v92 graph and accepted it, so the strip changed copy only, not structure or routing.

tasks.spec: python3 /home/ankit114/repos/paid_ads_mybcat/scripts/secret_exec.py --secret-env BLAND_API_KEY=mybcat/ai/api-keys/bland -- python3 -u /home/ankit114/repos/mott-v21-snap/scripts/mint_graph_version.py /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workT6mint/t6-strip-builder/v92_nofiller.json > minted.txt 2>&1; rc=$?; tail -8 minted.txt; exit $rc
tasks.check: grep -qiE 'version' minted.txt || { echo 'FAIL: mint output names no version:'; tail -8 minted.txt; exit 1; }; if grep -qiE 'attached' minted.txt && ! grep -qiE 'no numbers attached|not attached|unattached' minted.txt; then echo 'FAIL: mint output suggests a number attachment - inspect immediately:'; grep -i attached minted.txt; exit 1; fi; echo "PASS: unattached mint recorded - $(grep -iE 'version' minted.txt | head -2 | tr '\n' ' ')"
tasks.verified: The filler-stripped graph minted as a new UNATTACHED Bland pathway version (live 509 line untouched), version number on the record for the A/B measurement.
